scope: Close known R5 reception, news, media and seat-retention gaps on R6. Real local app HTTP/files/Git/npm/FFmpeg with isolated AI and cloud providers. Not commercial or Windows certification.

full_regression.skip: One pre-existing optional media quick-edit test; caption MP4 executed separately in browser integration.

navigation_smoke.scope: route visibility/navigation; not full end-to-end functionality of every tab

browser_backend: Linux Chromium in-memory shipped HTML/CSS/classic JS with authenticated bridge to real local app HTTP; 3D ES modules not loaded.
actual_outputs: Markdown article reviewed by separately configured fixture AI
Caption-only H.264 MP4 and SRT through actual FFmpeg, with byte-range streaming
Source ZIP after actual file writes, npm tests and Git merge
Existing R6 QR/source handoff exercised against synthetic cloud responses
not_tested: Actual Windows clean install, upgrade, GPU and device performance
Real AI accounts, billing and account-to-account failover with paid providers
Real Vercel/Supabase provisioning, current provider contracts and cross-user RLS
Live RSS availability/coverage; public DNS failed in the environment
Windows SAPI voice generation on Windows
Signed installer/update and customer pilot operation
Every arbitrary client business workflow or visual quality acceptance
not_implemented_here: General A-Z automation for arbitrary product types
In-place migration of existing client cloud databases
Automatic domain purchasing, payment/SMTP/OAuth account onboarding
Executable task adapters for catalog-only engines
Mobile/desktop installer generation for arbitrary produced apps
Cinematic text-to-video generation or guaranteed broadcast-quality news narration
externalWrites: none; no live cloud resources or public posts created
packaging_verification: Run SOURCE_SHA256 manifest validation after unpacking; hashes prove identity, not authorship or code signing.
